title: Regularization — Charge Rent for Complicated Knobs
key_insight: Regularization adds a cost for large weights. The model must balance fitting the examples with keeping its rule restrained.
body:
## Charge Rent for Complicated Knobs

A model can fit every training bump by turning its knobs to extreme values. Those fragile settings fail when the next sample changes slightly.

Regularization adds a cost for large weights. The model must balance fitting the examples with keeping its rule restrained.

The strength setting controls the rent. Too little allows memorization; too much flattens useful patterns.
common_mistakes: Applying penalties before putting features on comparable scales.
Choosing regularization strength on the test set.
Assuming a zero lasso weight proves a feature is useless in every context.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “Charge Rent for Complicated Knobs” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: It reduces brittle fits and stabilizes models with many or overlapping features.
